    91	overlap. This uses completeness but no encoding restriction or mass estimate. -/
    92	theorem tildeM_consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_decoded_overlap'
    93	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    94	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
    95	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    96	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
    97	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat =
    98	      1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
    99	        ∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   100	          (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   101	            S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
   102	              (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) := by
   103	  classical
   104	  let point := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
   105	    S.placedMeasurement .BB' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
   106	  let pulled : (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) → Measurement (PauliScalar P)
   107	      (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := fun u =>
   108	    Measurement.ofSumEqOne
   109	      (fun a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
   110	      (fun a => by
   111	        apply ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg
   112	        exact kronecker_nonneg (tildeM_isProj w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a).nonneg
   113	          Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
   114	      (by
   115	        rw [← S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, sum_tildeM_eq_one]
   116	        change reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   117	          (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   118	            (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
   119	        rw [heteroKron_one_one]
   120	        ext row col
   121	        simp [reindexOp, Matrix.one_apply])
   122	  have h := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap
   123	    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) pulled point S.psiHat
   124	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   125	  change consistencyDefect _ _ _ S.psiHat = 1 - avgOver _ (fun u =>
   126	    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   127	      (S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a) *
   128	        S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))) at h
   129	  refine h.trans ?_
   130	  congr 1
   131	  apply avgOver_congr
   132	  intro u
   133	  rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_tildeM_mul_pointMeas_eq_decoded_overlap,
   134	    stateQForm_finset_sum]
   135

   137	/-- On Alice's marginal, replacing polynomial evaluation by decoded evaluation
   138	loses at most the non-encoding mass. This is the support-restricted version of
   139	the fourth line of paper lines 1483--1492, with the players interchanged. -/
   140	theorem marginal_eval_overlap_le_decoded_add_nonencoding'
   141	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   142	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
   143	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   144	    (∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   145	      (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   146	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1)))) ≤
   147	      (∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   148	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   149	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
   150	            (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) +
   151	      ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
   152	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g)) := by
   153	  classical
   154	  have hpos (g : Poly P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
   155	      0 ≤ stateQForm S.psiHat
   156	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   157	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) :=
   158	    stateQForm_nonneg _ (S.place_mul_place_nonneg .AA' .BA'' (by trivial)
   159	      ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).pos g) ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).pos a))
   160	  have hsum (g : Poly P) :
   161	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   162	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   163	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))) =
   164	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g)) := by
   165	    have hc : (∑ a : PauliScalar P,
   166	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) = 1 :=
   167	      (S.placedMeasurement .BA'' (S.pointMeasExp .bob W u)).sum_eq_one
   168	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hc, mul_one]
   169	  rw [Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   170	  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   171	  intro g _
   172	  by_cases hg : IsEncoding g
   173	  · simp only [hg, not_true_eq_false, if_false, add_zero]
   174	    rw [decodeFq_dotProduct_indicatorVec hg u]
   175	    rfl
   176	  · simp only [hg, not_false_eq_true, if_true]
   177	    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun a _ => hpos g a)
   178	      (Finset.mem_univ (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))
   179	    rw [hsum] at hle
   180	    exact hle.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (hpos g _))

     4	/-!
     5	# Point overlaps for the difference-polynomial measurement
     6	
     7	Evaluation of the difference polynomial gives `g(u) - g_h(u)`. Unlike
     8	evaluation after decoding, this formula holds for every polynomial outcome.
     9	The resulting point overlaps are the ones supplied by the global witness.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	- Blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2.
    14	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1495-1545`,
    15	  especially `eq:qld-pulling-2b` and `eq:qld-pulling-12`.
    16	- The point-placement and convolution identities identify these overlaps with
    17	  the two consistency relations of the supplied global measurement.
    18	- Issue #520. These identities do not construct the global witness.
    19	-/

    30	/-- Evaluation of the difference measurement is a convolution with the ideal
    31	Pauli point projectors. No encoding hypothesis on `g` is needed. -/
    32	theorem pullingMeas_eval_effect {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    33	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    34	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    35	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
    36	    ((pullingMeas w side W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a =
    37	      ∑ g : Poly P, heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect g)
    38	        (tauDotProj W (indicatorVec u) (evalPoly g u - a)) := by
    39	  rw [pullingMeas, Measurement.postprocess_comp]
    40	  have heval (outcome : Poly P × PauliRegister P) :
    41	      evalPoly (pullingPoly outcome) u =
    42	        evalPoly outcome.1 u - dotProduct outcome.2 (indicatorVec u) := by
    43	    change MvPolynomial.eval u (outcome.1.1 - lowDegreeEncoding outcome.2) = _
    44	    rw [MvPolynomial.eval_sub]
    45	    exact congrArg (evalPoly outcome.1 u - ·) (lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct outcome.2 u)
    46	  simp only [Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter, heval,
    47	    tensorMeasurement, Measurement.ofSumEqOne, pauliRegisterMeas]
    48	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    49	  unfold tauDotProj bracketOp
    50	  simp_rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_right, Finset.sum_filter]
    51	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    52	  intro g _
    53	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    54	  intro h _
    55	  have hlabel : evalPoly g u - dotProduct h (indicatorVec u) = a ↔
    56	      dotProduct h (indicatorVec u) = evalPoly g u - a := by
    57	    constructor <;> intro heq <;> linear_combination -heq
    58	  simp only [hlabel]
    59	
    60	/-- Alice's evaluated difference measurement has precisely the overlap with
    61	Bob's point measurement in the Alice point-consistency estimate of the witness. -/
    62	theorem sum_pullingMeas_eval_mul_pointMeas {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    63	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    64	    (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    65	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.placeSide .alice
    66	      (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) *
    67	        S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) =
    68	      ∑ g : Poly P, S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
    69	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect (evalPoly g u)) := by
    70	  simp only [pullingMeas_eval_effect, S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    71	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    72	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    73	  intro g _
    74	  simp only [S.placeSide_alice_tensor_mul_placePlayer_bob]
    75	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← S.place_finset_sum, S.pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub .bob W u]
    76	  rfl

    78	/-- The reverse-player overlap uses the witness's Bob point-consistency relation, with
    79	the original `BB'` and `AB''` placements retained. -/
    80	theorem sum_pointMeas_mul_pullingMeas_eval {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    81	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    82	    (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    83	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) *
    84	      S.placeSide .bob
    85	        (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) =
    86	      ∑ g : Poly P, S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
    87	        S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect (evalPoly g u)) := by
    88	  simp only [pullingMeas_eval_effect, S.placeSide_bob_finset_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    89	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    90	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    91	  intro g _
    92	  simp only [S.placePlayer_alice_mul_placeSide_bob_tensor]
    93	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← S.place_finset_sum, S.pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub .alice W u]

    26	/-- The Alice evaluation defect is bounded by the supplied global consistency
    27	error, with no decoder correction or non-encoding mass term. -/
    28	theorem pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_alice {P : AdmissibleParams}
    29	    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    30	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
    31	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    32	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice
    33	        (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
    34	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤
    35	        deltaG := by
    36	  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    37	  let pulled := fun u => S.blockMeasurement .alice
    38	    ((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
    39	  let point := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BB' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
    40	  let marginal := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AA'
    41	    ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
    42	  let expanded := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BA'' (S.pointMeasExp .bob W u)
    43	  have hp := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu pulled point S.psiHat
    44	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
    45	  have hm := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu marginal expanded S.psiHat
    46	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
    47	  have heq : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (pulled u).effect a)
    48	      (fun u a => (point u).effect a) S.psiHat =
    49	      consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
    50	        (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat := by
    51	    rw [hp, hm]
    52	    apply congrArg (1 - ·)
    53	    apply avgOver_congr
    54	    intro u
    55	    simp only [pulled, point, marginal, expanded, ProjectiveSetting.blockMeasurement_effect,
    56	      ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect]
    57	    change (∑ a, stateQForm S.psiHat (S.placeSide .alice
    58	      (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) *
    59	      S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))) = _
    60	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_pullingMeas_eval_mul_pointMeas]
    61	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum]
    62	    exact congrArg (stateQForm S.psiHat)
    63	      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .AA' W u
    64	        (fun a => S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))).symm
    65	  have hbound := marginalPoly_pointMeas_consistent_alice w W
    66	  change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
    67	    (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ deltaG at hbound
    68	  exact heq.le.trans hbound
    69	
    70	/-- Bob's evaluation defect has the same bound, using the Bob point-consistency
    71	estimate of the supplied witness and its `BB'`--`AB''` placements. -/
    72	theorem pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_bob {P : AdmissibleParams}
    73	    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    74	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
    75	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    76	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
    77	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob
    78	        (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤
    79	        deltaG := by
    80	  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    81	  let pulled := fun u => S.blockMeasurement .bob
    82	    ((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
    83	  let point := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AA' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .alice W u))
    84	  let marginal := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BB'
    85	    ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
    86	  let expanded := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AB'' (S.pointMeasExp .alice W u)
    87	  have hp := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu point pulled S.psiHat
    88	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
    89	  have hm := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu marginal expanded S.psiHat
    90	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
    91	  have heq : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (point u).effect a)
    92	      (fun u a => (pulled u).effect a) S.psiHat =
    93	      consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
    94	        (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat := by
    95	    rw [hp, hm]
    96	    apply congrArg (1 - ·)
    97	    apply avgOver_congr
    98	    intro u
    99	    simp only [pulled, point, marginal, expanded, ProjectiveSetting.blockMeasurement_effect,
   100	      ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect]
   101	    change (∑ a, stateQForm S.psiHat
   102	      (S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) * S.placeSide .bob
   103	        (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))) = _
   104	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_pointMeas_mul_pullingMeas_eval]

   106	    exact congrArg (stateQForm S.psiHat)
   107	      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .BB' W u
   108	        (fun a => S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a))).symm
   109	  have hbound := marginalPoly_pointMeas_consistent_bob w W
   110	  change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
   111	    (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ deltaG at hbound
   112	  exact heq.le.trans hbound

   147	    ((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))

   151	    (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
   152	  have hA := (opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect mu A PB S.psiHat).trans

   131	  have hm : nonencodingMarginalMass w .bob W ≤
   132	      deltaG + C * Real.sqrt epsilon + (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
   133	    unfold nonencodingMarginalMass
   134	    change (∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
   135	      stateQForm S.psiHat (S.placeSide .bob
   136	        (heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) (1 : Op (PauliRegister P))))) ≤ _
   137	    simp_rw [stateQForm_placeSide_bob_tensor_one S _
   138	      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).pos _)).isHermitian]
   139	    exact hmass.trans (add_le_add href le_rfl)
   140	  unfold deltaConstructPaulis
   141	  rw [Nat.cast_mul]
   142	  have hratio : 0 ≤ (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by positivity

   147	/-- For a supplied global polynomial-pair witness, the Alice-pulled/Bob-point
   148	defect is bounded by its point-consistency error plus Alice's non-encoding
   149	mass. This is the register-interchanged, support-restricted calculation in
   150	paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1483-1492`, supporting blueprint
   151	`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`. The estimate uses no bound for that mass; see
   152	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex` for the decoder restriction. -/
   153	theorem tildeM_consistencyDefect_le_deltaG_add_nonencoding'
   154	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   155	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   156	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   157	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
   158	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤
   159	      deltaG + nonencodingMarginalMass w .alice W := by
   160	  classical
   161	  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   162	  let evaluated := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
   163	    S.placedMeasurement .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).postprocess
   164	      (fun g => MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))
   165	  let expanded := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
   166	    S.placedMeasurement .BA'' (S.pointMeasExp .bob W u)
   167	  have hdefect := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu evaluated expanded S.psiHat
   168	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   169	  have hw := marginalPoly_pointMeas_consistent_alice w W
   170	  change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (evaluated u).effect a)
   171	    (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ deltaG at hw
   172	  rw [hdefect] at hw
   173	  have hregroup (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   174	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   175	        ((evaluated u).effect a * (expanded u).effect a)) =
   176	      ∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   177	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   178	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
   179	            (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))) := by
   180	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum]
   181	    change stateQForm S.psiHat
   182	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.place .AA'
   183	        (((w.marginalPoly .alice W).postprocess
   184	          (fun g => MvPolynomial.eval u g.1)).effect a) *
   185	            S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) = _
   186	    exact (congrArg (stateQForm S.psiHat)
   187	      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .AA' W u
   188	        (fun a => S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)))).trans
   189	      (stateQForm_finset_sum _ _ _)
   190	  simp only [hregroup] at hw
   191	  have hcompare := avgOver_mono mu _ _
   192	    (fun u => marginal_eval_overlap_le_decoded_add_nonencoding' w W u)
   193	  rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_const_of_isProbability mu
   194	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)] at hcompare
   195	  have hmass_eq : nonencodingMarginalMass w .alice W =
   196	      ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
   197	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g)) := by
   198	    unfold nonencodingMarginalMass
   199	    simp only [S.placeSide_alice_tensor_one]
   200	    rfl
   201	  rw [← hmass_eq] at hcompare
   202	  rw [tildeM_consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_decoded_overlap']
   203	  dsimp only [mu] at hw hcompare
   204	  linarith

   209	supplied-witness form of the register-interchanged display of Item 1 in paper
   210	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1463-1492`.

   212	The conclusion uses the same explicit construction scale as the first player

     9	# Consistency with encoding-supported reference measurements
    10	
    11	The Pauli-basis check remains a consistency estimate after adjoining the
    12	perfectly correlated ideal point measurement. Schwartz-Zippel then controls
    13	mass outside the encoding image by evaluated reference inconsistency.
    14	
    15	## References
    16	
    17	- Blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass` and `lem:qld-nonencoding-mass-bound`.
    18	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:197-264,383-418`.
    19	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.
    20	- The reference measurements and comparison estimates express the convolution
    21	  with the ideal Pauli point projectors.
    22	- These are auxiliary estimates for a supplied witness, not its construction.

    35	/-- For commuting families, reversing the order of the measurements preserves
    36	the consistency defect. This is finite-sum algebra for opposite placements. -/
    37	theorem consistencyDefect_comm_of_commute {X A I : Type*}
    38	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    39	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (mu : Distribution X)
    40	    (first second : X → A → Op I) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I)
    41	    (hcomm : ∀ x a b, first x a * second x b = second x b * first x a) :
    42	    consistencyDefect mu first second psi = consistencyDefect mu second first psi := by
    43	  unfold consistencyDefect
    44	  apply avgOver_congr
    45	  intro x
    46	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    47	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    48	  intro b _
    49	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    50	  intro a _
    51	  simp only [hcomm x a b, eq_comm]

    53	/-- A polynomial measurement's mass outside the encoding image is at most
    54	its evaluated inconsistency with an encoding-supported reference, plus `md/q`.
    55	This is the Schwartz-Zippel step in blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`.
    56	The reference support is explicit because this auxiliary applies to any POVM;
    57	the concrete reference above proves it without an additional strategy premise. -/
    58	theorem mass_outside_encoding_le_evaluated_defect {P : AdmissibleParams}
    59	    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    60	    (meas : Measurement (Poly P) I) (reference : Measurement (Poly P) J)
    61	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1)
    62	    (hsupport : ∀ g, ¬ IsEncoding g → reference.effect g = 0) :
    63	    (∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
    64	      stateQForm psi (heteroKron (meas.effect g) 1)) ≤
    65	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    66	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((meas.postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
    67	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((reference.postprocess
    68	          (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) psi + (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
    69	  classical
    70	  have hmass := mass_outside_support_le_point_defect meas reference psi
    71	    (Finset.univ.filter IsEncoding) (by simpa using hsupport)
    72	  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hmass
    73	  have hcollision := SandwichProduct.point_codeword_defect_le_avg_evaluated_add
    74	    meas reference psi evalPoly ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) hpsi
    75	    (by positivity) poly_eval_collision_le
    76	  refine hmass.trans (hcollision.trans_eq ?_)
    77	  rw [SandwichProduct.consistencyDefect_placed_eq_avg_point]

    81	/-- The ideal point measurement has zero off-diagonal mass on its EPR pair.

    83	private theorem tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero {P : AdmissibleParams}
    84	    (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    85	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, ∑ b : PauliScalar P, if a = b then 0 else

    87	        (heteroKron (tauPointProj W u a) (tauPointProj W u b))) = 0 := by
    88	  have h := point_defect_eq (leftPlacedMeasurement (tauPointMeas W u))
    89	    (rightPlacedMeasurement (tauPointMeas W u)) (eprState (PauliRegister P))
    90	  simpa only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement, Measurement.ofSumEqOne,
    91	    placed_product_stateQForm_eq, tauPointMeas, eprState_norm, one_pow,
    92	    sum_tauPointProj_pair_stateQForm_eprState, sub_self] using h

    94	/-- Adjoining the ideal point outcomes preserves the Pauli-basis check on the
    95	two-player expanded state, in the point--Pauli orientation. -/
    96	theorem point_encodingPauli_consistency_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
    97	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (W : PauliKind) :
    98	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    99	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a) 1)
   100	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (((S.encodingPauliMeas .bob W).postprocess
   101	          (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) =
   102	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   103	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) 1)
   104	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u).effect a))
   105	        S.toStrategy.ψ := by
   106	  have h := consistencyDefect_convolution_eq_of_perfect
   107	    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   108	    (S.pointMeas .alice W) (S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W)
   109	    (tauPointMeas W) (tauPointMeas W) S.toStrategy.ψ
   110	    (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)
   111	    (tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero W)
   112	  simpa only [pointMeasExp, Measurement.ofSumEqOne, expPointOp_eq_convolution,
   113	    encodingPauliMeas_eval_effect_eq_convolution, tauPointMeas,
   114	    ExtendedLineGame.pairState] using h

   163	theorem right_mass_outside_encoding_le_evaluated_defect {P : AdmissibleParams}

   182	/-- Both evaluated global marginals are consistent with the opposite

   186	theorem global_marginal_encoding_consistency :
   187	    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon deltaG : ℝ),
   188	      0 ≤ epsilon → ∀ (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
   189	        (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind),
   190	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   191	          (fun u a => heteroKron (((w.marginalPoly .alice W).postprocess
   192	            (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
   193	          (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (((S.encodingPauliMeas .bob W).postprocess
   194	            (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) ≤
   195	        deltaG + C * Real.sqrt epsilon ∧
   196	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   197	          (fun u a => heteroKron (((S.encodingPauliMeas .alice W).postprocess
   198	            (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
   199	          (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (((w.marginalPoly .bob W).postprocess
   200	            (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) ≤
   201	        deltaG + C * Real.sqrt epsilon := by
   202	  obtain ⟨C1, hC1, hforward⟩ := win_pauli_basis_cons
   203	  obtain ⟨C2, hC2, hreverse⟩ := WinImplications.win_pauli_basis_cons_interchanged_proof
   204	  let E : ℝ := Fintype.card PauliEdge
   205	  let K : ℝ := max C1 C2
   206	  refine ⟨1 + 2 * Real.sqrt (E + K), by linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (E + K)], ?_⟩
   207	  intro P epsilon deltaG hepsilon S w W
   208	  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   209	  let psi := ExtendedLineGame.pairState S
   210	  let pointA := fun u => leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)
   211	    (S.pointMeasExp .alice W u)
   212	  let pointB := fun u => rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)
   213	    (S.pointMeasExp .bob W u)
   214	  let refA := fun u => leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)
   215	    ((S.encodingPauliMeas .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
   216	  let refB := fun u => rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)
   217	    ((S.encodingPauliMeas .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
   218	  let margA := fun u => leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)
   219	    ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
   220	  let margB := fun u => rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)
   221	    ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
   222	  have hpost (side : PlayerSide) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   223	      (w.marginalPoly side W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u) =
   224	        (w.Smeas side).postprocess (evalAt W u) := by
   225	    rw [GlobalPairWitness.marginalPoly, Measurement.postprocess_comp]
   226	    cases W <;> rfl

   228	      (fun u a => (pointB u).effect a) psi ≤ deltaG := by
   229	    change consistencyDefect mu
   230	      (fun u a => heteroKron (((w.marginalPoly .alice W).postprocess
   231	        (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
   232	      (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) psi ≤ deltaG
   233	    rw [S.consistencyDefect_pairState_eq_AA'_BA'']
   234	    simpa only [hpost] using w.point_consistent_alice W
   235	  have hba : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (margB u).effect a)
   236	      (fun u a => (pointA u).effect a) psi ≤ deltaG := by
   237	    rw [consistencyDefect_comm_of_commute _ _ _ _ (by
   238	      intro u a b
   239	      exact (WinImplications.heteroKron_left_right_comm _ _).symm)]
   240	    change consistencyDefect mu
   241	      (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a) 1)
   242	      (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (((w.marginalPoly .bob W).postprocess
   243	        (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) psi ≤ deltaG
   244	    rw [S.consistencyDefect_pairState_eq_AB''_BB',
   245	      consistencyDefect_comm_of_commute _ _ _ _ (by
   246	        intro u a b
   247	        exact S.place_comm .AB'' .BB' trivial _ _)]
   248	    simpa only [hpost] using w.point_consistent_bob W
   249	  have hpoints : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (pointA u).effect a)
   250	      (fun u a => (pointB u).effect a) psi ≤ E * epsilon := by
   251	    change consistencyDefect mu
   252	      (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a) 1)
   253	      (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) psi ≤ _
   254	    rw [S.expanded_point_consistency_eq]
   255	    exact point_self_consistency_le S W
   256	  have hpoints' : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (pointB u).effect a)
   257	      (fun u a => (pointA u).effect a) psi ≤ E * epsilon := by
   258	    rw [consistencyDefect_comm_of_commute _ _ _ _ (by
   259	      intro u a b
   260	      exact (WinImplications.heteroKron_left_right_comm _ _).symm)]
   261	    exact hpoints
   262	  have hpb : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (pointA u).effect a)
   263	      (fun u a => (refB u).effect a) psi ≤ K * epsilon := by
   264	    change consistencyDefect mu
   265	      (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a) 1)
   266	      (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (((S.encodingPauliMeas .bob W).postprocess
   267	        (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) psi ≤ _
   268	    rw [S.point_encodingPauli_consistency_eq]
   269	    exact (hforward P epsilon S hepsilon W).trans
   270	      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hepsilon)
   271	  have hpa : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (pointB u).effect a)
   272	      (fun u a => (refA u).effect a) psi ≤ K * epsilon := by
   273	    rw [consistencyDefect_comm_of_commute _ _ _ _ (by
   274	      intro u a b
   275	      exact (WinImplications.heteroKron_left_right_comm _ _).symm)]
   276	    change consistencyDefect mu
   277	      (fun u a => heteroKron (((S.encodingPauliMeas .alice W).postprocess
   278	        (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
   279	      (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) psi ≤ _
   280	    rw [S.encodingPauli_point_consistency_eq]
   281	    exact (hreverse P epsilon S hepsilon W).trans
   282	      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hepsilon)
   283	  have hscalar : deltaG + 2 * Real.sqrt (E * epsilon + K * epsilon) ≤
   284	      deltaG + (1 + 2 * Real.sqrt (E + K)) * Real.sqrt epsilon := by
   285	    have hEK : 0 ≤ E + K := add_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
   286	      (le_trans (by linarith : 0 ≤ C1) (le_max_left _ _))
   287	    rw [← add_mul, Real.sqrt_mul hEK]
   288	    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg epsilon]
   289	  constructor
   290	  · exact (consistencyDefect_trans_le mu margA pointB pointA refB psi
   291	      deltaG (E * epsilon) (K * epsilon) (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   292	      (ExtendedLineGame.pairState_norm S) hab hpoints hpb).trans hscalar
   293	  · have h := (consistencyDefect_trans_le mu margB pointA pointB refA psi
   294	      deltaG (E * epsilon) (K * epsilon) (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   295	      (ExtendedLineGame.pairState_norm S) hba hpoints' hpa).trans hscalar
   296	    rw [consistencyDefect_comm_of_commute _ _ _ _ (by
   297	      intro u a b
   298	      exact (WinImplications.heteroKron_left_right_comm _ _).symm)] at h
   299	    exact h

   301	/-- A marginal acting on `AA'` has the same mass in the extraction-block
   302	notation and the two-player expanded state. The unused registers carry identities. -/
   303	theorem stateQForm_placeSide_alice_tensor_one {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
   304	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice))
   305	    (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
   306	    stateQForm S.psiHat (S.placeSide .alice (heteroKron A (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)))) =
   307	      stateQForm (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) (heteroKron A 1) := by
   308	  have hplace : S.placeSide .alice (heteroKron A (1 : Op (PauliRegister P))) =
   309	      S.place .AA' A := by
   310	    ext row col
   311	    simp only [placeSide, sixRegExtractionEquiv, reindexOp, place, heteroKron,
   312	      Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply, mul_ite, ite_mul]
   313	    split_ifs <;> simp_all
   314	    rfl
   315	  rw [hplace]
   316	  have h := ExtendedLineGame.stateQForm_pairState_eq_AA'_BA'' S A 1 hA
   317	    Matrix.isHermitian_one
   318	  have hone : S.place .BA'' (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)) = 1 := by
   319	    convert S.place_one .BA'' using 1
   320	    rfl
   321	  rw [hone, Matrix.mul_one] at h
   322	  exact h.symm
   323	
   324	/-- The corresponding marginal-mass identity for `BB'`. The opposite placement
   325	uses the second EPR pair, as in the witness's Bob consistency hypothesis. -/
   326	theorem stateQForm_placeSide_bob_tensor_one {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
   327	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob))
   328	    (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
   329	    stateQForm S.psiHat (S.placeSide .bob (heteroKron B (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)))) =
   330	      stateQForm (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) (heteroKron 1 B) := by
   331	  have hplace : S.placeSide .bob (heteroKron B (1 : Op (PauliRegister P))) =
   332	      S.place .BB' B := by
   333	    ext row col
   334	    simp only [placeSide, sixRegExtractionEquiv, reindexOp, place, heteroKron,
   335	      Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply, mul_ite, ite_mul]
   336	    split_ifs <;> simp_all
   337	    rfl
   338	  rw [hplace]
   339	  have h := ExtendedLineGame.stateQForm_pairState_eq_AB''_BB' S 1 B
   340	    Matrix.isHermitian_one hB
   341	  have hone : S.place .AB'' (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) = 1 := by
   342	    convert S.place_one .AB'' using 1
   343	    rfl
   344	  rw [hone, Matrix.one_mul] at h
   345	  exact h.symm

     3	/-! # Consistency under independent additive convolution
     4	
     5	Adding the outcomes of an independently perfectly correlated ancillary measurement
     6	pair preserves the consistency defect. The four register types are independent;
     7	`prodShuffle` places the two registers of each player next to one another.
     8	
     9	These are formalization-only auxiliary identities. Perfect ancillary correlation
    10	is a hypothesis of the generic result, to be proved for the Pauli measurements
    11	before applying it to the expanded point construction.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:367-438`,
    16	  the expanded state and the convolution formula for expanded point effects.
    17	- The same paper, `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`.
    18	- Blueprint `def:expanded-state` and `def:expanded-point-measurement`.
    19	- Issue #266; the ideal-point specialization is the separate issue #267.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    23	
    24	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    25	
    26	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    27	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

    29	section Factorization
    30	
    31	variable {ιA ιB κA κB : Type*}
    32	  [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    33	  [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
    34	
    35	/-- Joint expectations factor after regrouping an independent pair of bipartite
    36	states by player. The shuffle sends `((i, j), (k, l))` to `((i, k), (j, l))`. -/
    37	theorem inner_prodShuffle_vecTensor_heteroKron
    38	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB))
    39	    (A : Op ιA) (B : Op ιB) (R : Op κA) (T : Op κB) :
    40	    inner ℂ (reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor ψ φ))
    41	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (heteroKron A R) (heteroKron B T))
    42	          (reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor ψ φ))) =
    43	      inner ℂ ψ (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron A B) ψ) *
    44	        inner ℂ φ (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron R T) φ) := by
    45	  simp only [applyOperatorToState, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply,
    46	    EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
    47	  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    48	  rw [← (prodShuffle : (ιA × ιB) × (κA × κB) ≃ _).sum_comp]
    49	  simp_rw [← (prodShuffle : (ιA × ιB) × (κA × κB) ≃ _).sum_comp]
    50	  change (∑ p : (ιA × ιB) × (κA × κB), ∑ q : (ιA × ιB) × (κA × κB),
    51	    ((A p.1.1 q.1.1 * R p.2.1 q.2.1) * (B p.1.2 q.1.2 * T p.2.2 q.2.2) *
    52	      (ψ q.1 * φ q.2)) * star (ψ p.1 * φ p.2)) =
    53	    ∑ i : ιA × ιB, ∑ j : ιA × ιB, ∑ k : κA × κB, ∑ l : κA × κB,
    54	      ((A i.1 j.1 * B i.2 j.2 * ψ j) * star (ψ i)) *
    55	        ((R k.1 l.1 * T k.2 l.2 * φ l) * star (φ k))
    56	  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type (α₁ := ιA × ιB) (α₂ := κA × κB), star_mul]
    57	  conv_lhs =>
    58	    arg 2
    59	    ext i
    60	    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    61	  congr! 4 with i j k l
    62	  ring
    63	
    64	/-- For positive ancillary effects, the real joint expectation factors on the
    65	shuffled tensor state. No normalization or positivity of `A` and `B` is needed. -/
    66	theorem stateQForm_prodShuffle_vecTensor_heteroKron
    67	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB))
    68	    (A : Op ιA) (B : Op ιB) {R : Op κA} {T : Op κB}
    69	    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    70	    stateQForm (reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor ψ φ))
    71	        (heteroKron (heteroKron A R) (heteroKron B T)) =
    72	      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron A B) * stateQForm φ (heteroKron R T) := by
    73	  have hnonneg := (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
    74	    (kronecker_nonneg hR hT)).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg φ.ofLp
    75	  have him : (inner ℂ φ (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron R T) φ)).im = 0 := by
    76	    simpa only [applyOperatorToState, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply,
    77	      EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm, heteroKron] using
    78	      (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp hnonneg).2.symm
    79	  simp only [stateQForm, inner_prodShuffle_vecTensor_heteroKron, Complex.mul_re,
    80	    him, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    81	
    82	end Factorization

    84	/-- An additive convolution of effect families can be indexed by the ancillary
    85	answer alone. This is the finite-fiber form of the expanded point construction. -/
    86	theorem sum_add_fiber_heteroKron {G ι κ : Type*}
    87	    [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] [AddCommGroup G]
    88	    (A : G → Op ι) (R : G → Op κ) (z : G) :
    89	    (∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p : G × G => p.1 + p.2 = z),
    90	      heteroKron (A p.1) (R p.2)) =
    91	      ∑ c : G, heteroKron (A (z - c)) (R c) := by
    92	  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
    93	  simp only [← eq_sub_iff_add_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    94	
    95	/-- Averaging a common additive shift preserves the off-diagonal mass of any
    96	weight function. The ancillary joint weights are supported on the diagonal
    97	and have total diagonal mass one. -/
    98	private theorem sum_convolution_off_diagonal_eq {G : Type*}
    99	    [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] [AddCommGroup G]
   100	    (p q : G → G → ℝ) (hzero : ∀ c d, c ≠ d → q c d = 0)
   101	    (hdiag : ∑ c : G, q c c = 1) :
   102	    (∑ z : G, ∑ w : G, if z = w then 0 else
   103	      ∑ c : G, ∑ d : G, p (z - c) (w - d) * q c d) =
   104	      ∑ a : G, ∑ b : G, if a = b then 0 else p a b := by
   105	  have hinner (z w c : G) :
   106	      (∑ d : G, p (z - c) (w - d) * q c d) =
   107	        p (z - c) (w - c) * q c c := by
   108	    apply Finset.sum_eq_single c
   109	    · intro d _ hdc
   110	      rw [hzero c d hdc.symm, mul_zero]
   111	    · simp
   112	  have hshift (c : G) :
   113	      (∑ z : G, ∑ w : G, if z = w then 0 else p (z - c) (w - c)) =
   114	        ∑ a : G, ∑ b : G, if a = b then 0 else p a b := by
   115	    refine Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.subRight c) _ _ fun z => ?_
   116	    refine Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.subRight c) _ _ fun w => ?_
   117	    change (if z = w then 0 else p (z - c) (w - c)) =
   118	      if z - c = w - c then 0 else p (z - c) (w - c)
   119	    simp only [sub_left_inj]
   120	  simp_rw [hinner]
   121	  calc
   122	    (∑ z : G, ∑ w : G, if z = w then 0 else
   123	        ∑ c : G, p (z - c) (w - c) * q c c) =
   124	        ∑ z : G, ∑ w : G, ∑ c : G,
   125	          (if z = w then 0 else p (z - c) (w - c)) * q c c := by
   126	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   127	      intro z _
   128	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   129	      intro w _
   130	      by_cases hzw : z = w <;> simp [hzw]
   131	    _ = ∑ c : G, (∑ z : G, ∑ w : G,
   132	        if z = w then 0 else p (z - c) (w - c)) * q c c := by
   133	      simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
   134	      conv_lhs =>
   135	        arg 2
   136	        ext z
   137	        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   138	      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   139	    _ = _ := by
   140	      simp_rw [hshift]
   141	      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hdiag, mul_one]
   142	
   143	/-- Independent additive convolution with a normalized, perfectly correlated
   144	ancillary POVM pair preserves the consistency defect exactly. All four register
   145	types may differ, and neither the original state nor the question distribution
   146	needs to be normalized. No measurement is assumed projective.
   147	
   148	This is a generic auxiliary for the expanded point construction in paper
   149	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:367-438` and
   150	`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, not the latter paper theorem. Its ancillary
   151	perfection hypothesis must be established for the concrete ideal measurements
   152	before specialization; that application is tracked in issue #267. -/
   153	theorem consistencyDefect_convolution_eq_of_perfect
   154	    {X G ιA ιB κA κB : Type*}
   155	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] [AddCommGroup G]
   156	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   157	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   158	    (μ : Distribution X) (A : X → Measurement G ιA) (B : X → Measurement G ιB)
   159	    (R : X → Measurement G κA) (T : X → Measurement G κB)
   160	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB))
   161	    (hφ : ‖φ‖ = 1)
   162	    (hperfect : ∀ x, (∑ c : G, ∑ d : G, if c = d then 0 else
   163	      stateQForm φ (heteroKron ((R x).effect c) ((T x).effect d))) = 0) :
   164	    consistencyDefect μ
   165	        (fun x z => heteroKron
   166	          (∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p : G × G => p.1 + p.2 = z),
   167	            heteroKron ((A x).effect p.1) ((R x).effect p.2)) 1)
   168	        (fun x z => heteroKron 1
   169	          (∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p : G × G => p.1 + p.2 = z),
   170	            heteroKron ((B x).effect p.1) ((T x).effect p.2)))
   171	        (reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor ψ φ)) =
   172	      consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).effect a) 1)
   173	        (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect b)) ψ := by
   174	  unfold consistencyDefect
   175	  simp_rw [consistency_term_eq_stateQForm, placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
   176	  apply avgOver_congr
   177	  intro x
   178	  let q : G → G → ℝ := fun c d =>
   179	    stateQForm φ (heteroKron ((R x).effect c) ((T x).effect d))
   180	  have hnonneg (c d : G) : 0 ≤ q c d :=
   181	    stateQForm_nonneg φ (kronecker_nonneg ((R x).pos c) ((T x).pos d))
   182	  have hoff (c d : G) : 0 ≤ (if c = d then 0 else q c d) := by
   183	    split_ifs
   184	    · exact le_rfl
   185	    · exact hnonneg c d
   186	  have hzero (c d : G) (hcd : c ≠ d) : q c d = 0 := by
   187	    have hrow := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
   188	      (fun c _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hoff c d))).mp (hperfect x)
   189	    have hterm := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
   190	      (fun d _ => hoff c d)).mp (hrow c (Finset.mem_univ c)) d (Finset.mem_univ d)
   191	    simpa only [if_neg hcd] using hterm
   192	  have hdiag : ∑ c : G, q c c = 1 := by
   193	    have h := point_defect_eq (leftPlacedMeasurement (R x))
   194	      (rightPlacedMeasurement (T x)) φ
   195	    simp only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement, Measurement.ofSumEqOne,
   196	      placed_product_stateQForm_eq, hperfect x, hφ, one_pow] at h
   197	    dsimp only [q]
   198	    linarith
   199	  have hfactor (a b c d : G) := stateQForm_prodShuffle_vecTensor_heteroKron ψ φ
   200	    ((A x).effect a) ((B x).effect b) ((R x).pos c) ((T x).pos d)
   201	  simp_rw [sum_add_fiber_heteroKron, heteroKron_finset_sum_left,
   202	    heteroKron_finset_sum_right, stateQForm_finset_sum, hfactor]
   203	  exact sum_convolution_off_diagonal_eq
   204	    (fun a b => stateQForm ψ (heteroKron ((A x).effect a) ((B x).effect b)))
   205	    q hzero hdiag
   206

     4	/-!
     5	# Real polynomial collision bounds
     6	
     7	The existing Schwartz–Zippel estimate for bounded polynomial representatives
     8	is expressed as a nonnegative rational cardinality ratio. This module converts
     9	it to the real uniform average used by the sandwich support comparison and
    10	specializes it to the polynomial outcomes of the Pauli basis test.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	* `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex`, `lem:schwartz-zippel`.
    15	* Blueprint `lem:schwartz-zippel-individual` and the collision calculation
    16	  preceding `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass` in `sec:separating`.
    17	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1483-1492`,
    18	  the consistency calculation in `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` whose decoder
    19	  substitution requires the blueprint's nonencoding-mass estimate.
    20	* `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`, for that substitution's scope.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    24	
    25	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
    26	
    27	/-- Two distinct individual-degree-`d` polynomial representatives agree on at
    28	most an `m * d / |K|` fraction of field points, expressed as a real uniform
    29	average. This is the scalar collision estimate used before blueprint
    30	`eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`, not the nonencoding-mass estimate itself.
    31	
    32	The field is finite and hence nonempty. No positive dimension, positive degree,
    33	or degree bound relative to the field size is required; representatives are
    34	not identified merely because their evaluations agree. -/
    35	theorem polyFunc_eval_collision_le {m d : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    36	    [DecidableEq K] (first second : polyFunc m K d) (hne : first ≠ second) :
    37	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin m → K))
    38	      (fun point => if MvPolynomial.eval point first.1 = MvPolynomial.eval point second.1
    39	        then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (m * d : ℝ) / Fintype.card K := by
    40	  have havg :
    41	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin m → K))
    42	        (fun point => if MvPolynomial.eval point first.1 = MvPolynomial.eval point second.1
    43	          then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
    44	        (polynomialAgreementProbability m K first.1 second.1 : ℝ) := by
    45	    rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_filter]
    46	    simp [polynomialAgreementProbability, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
    47	  rw [havg]
    48	  have hbound := schwartzZippel_individualDegree first second hne
    49	  have hreal : (polynomialAgreementProbability m K first.1 second.1 : ℝ) ≤
    50	      ((((m * d : ℕ) : ℚ≥0) / Fintype.card K) : ℝ) := by
    51	    exact_mod_cast hbound
    52	  simpa using hreal
    53

     7	This module places a complete measurement from either player's three-register
     8	extraction block on the full six-register space. It also records the transport

    32	    (A : Measurement α (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
    33	    Measurement α (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
    34	  refine Measurement.ofSumEqOne (fun a => S.placeSide side (A.effect a)) ?_ ?_
    35	  · intro a

    37	    · exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (kronecker_nonneg (A.pos a) Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)

    43	      rw [heteroKron_one_one]
    44	      ext row col

    62	    (hA : Measurement.IsProjective A) :
    63	    Measurement.IsProjective (S.blockMeasurement side A) := by
    64	  classical

    88	    instDecidableEqProd

    92	    (S.place .AA' (heteroKron A 1) * S.place .BB' (heteroKron B 1)) = _

    95	    S.reindexOp_sixRegShuffle_place_BB'_heteroKron]

    97	  rw [stateQForm_vecTensor_heteroKron _ _ _ _

   103	/-- Adjoining the two EPR pairs preserves the consistency defect between
   104	families of original-register measurements. -/
   105	theorem consistencyDefect_placePlayers {X α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   106	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
   107	    (mu : Distribution X) (A : X → Measurement α S.toStrategy.ιA)
   108	    (B : X → Measurement α S.toStrategy.ιB) :

   111	      consistencyDefect mu (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).effect a) 1)
   112	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect a)) S.toStrategy.ψ := by
   113	  unfold consistencyDefect
   114	  apply avgOver_congr
   115	  intro x
   116	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   117	  intro a _
   118	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

    26	/-- The Alice evaluation defect is bounded by the supplied global consistency
    27	error, with no decoder correction or non-encoding mass term. -/
    28	theorem pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_alice {P : AdmissibleParams}
    29	    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    30	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
    31	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    32	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice
    33	        (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
    34	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤
    35	        deltaG := by
    36	  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    37	  let pulled := fun u => S.blockMeasurement .alice
    38	    ((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
    39	  let point := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BB' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
    40	  let marginal := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AA'
    41	    ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
    42	  let expanded := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BA'' (S.pointMeasExp .bob W u)
    43	  have hp := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu pulled point S.psiHat
    44	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
    45	  have hm := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu marginal expanded S.psiHat
    46	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
    47	  have heq : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (pulled u).effect a)
    48	      (fun u a => (point u).effect a) S.psiHat =
    49	      consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
    50	        (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat := by
    51	    rw [hp, hm]
    52	    apply congrArg (1 - ·)
    53	    apply avgOver_congr
    54	    intro u
    55	    simp only [pulled, point, marginal, expanded, ProjectiveSetting.blockMeasurement_effect,
    56	      ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect]
    57	    change (∑ a, stateQForm S.psiHat (S.placeSide .alice
    58	      (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) *
    59	      S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))) = _
    60	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_pullingMeas_eval_mul_pointMeas]
    61	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum]
    62	    exact congrArg (stateQForm S.psiHat)
    63	      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .AA' W u
    64	        (fun a => S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))).symm
    65	  have hbound := marginalPoly_pointMeas_consistent_alice w W
    66	  change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
    67	    (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ deltaG at hbound
    68	  exact heq.le.trans hbound

    70	/-- Bob's evaluation defect has the same bound, using the Bob point-consistency
    71	estimate of the supplied witness and its `BB'`--`AB''` placements. -/
    72	theorem pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_bob {P : AdmissibleParams}
    73	    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    74	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
    75	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    76	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
    77	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob
    78	        (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤
    79	        deltaG := by
    80	  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    81	  let pulled := fun u => S.blockMeasurement .bob

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Points.Commutation
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction.Observables
+
+/-!
+# Finite-character estimates for extracted observables
+
+Parseval identifies the uniform average over field characters with the sum of
+squared outcome norms. A fixed binary basis character instead admits a bound
+by four times the consistency defect, using binary postprocessing.
+
+## References
+
+These are finite-dimensional auxiliary results for blueprint
+`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2, and paper
+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1542-1551`.
+They do not assert the preceding pulled-apart measurement comparison
+`eq:qld-pulling-cons`, which remains an obligation of issue #520.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
+open WinImplications
+
+noncomputable section
+
+/-- Parseval for the fixed field trace, with a uniform character average and
+an unnormalized outcome sum. This specializes the orthogonality theorem used
+for blueprint `lem:qld-4-10`; no measurement assumptions are needed. -/
+theorem avg_norm_fixed_character_sum_sq {P : AdmissibleParams} {E : Type*}
+    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] (v : PauliScalar P → E) :
+    avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliScalar P)) (fun r =>
+      ‖∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * a)) • v a‖ ^ 2) =
+      ∑ a, ‖v a‖ ^ 2 := by
+  classical
+  have horth (a b : PauliScalar P) :
+      ∑ r : PauliScalar P,
+        (starRingEnd ℂ) (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * a))) *
+          phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * b)) =
+        if a = b then ((Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0 := by
+    simpa only [← Complex.star_def, star_phaseSign, Complex.ofReal_natCast] using
+      sum_fixedCharacter_mul_fixedCharacter a b
+  rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum,
+    sum_norm_sum_smul_sq_of_orthogonal _ _ horth v, ← mul_assoc,
+    inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero), one_mul]
+
+/-- Multiplication by a chosen basis element only permutes the characters.
+The basis coordinate is fixed, not averaged, in this normalized Parseval
+identity supporting blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2. -/
+theorem avg_norm_basis_character_sum_sq {P : AdmissibleParams} {E : Type*}
+    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
+    (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) (v : PauliScalar P → E) :
+    avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliScalar P)) (fun r =>
+      ‖∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * r * a)) • v a‖ ^ 2) =
+      ∑ a, ‖v a‖ ^ 2 := by
+  classical
+  rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
+  have hsum := Equiv.sum_comp
+    (Equiv.mulLeft₀ (P.model.basis j) (P.model.basis.ne_zero j))
+    (fun r => ‖∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * a)) • v a‖ ^ 2)
+  change (∑ r, ‖∑ a,
+    phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * r * a)) • v a‖ ^ 2) = _ at hsum
+  rw [hsum]
+  exact (avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum _).symm.trans
+    (avg_norm_fixed_character_sum_sq v)
+
+/-- Regroup a field-weighted observable by its binary trace label. This is the
+postprocessing at paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1547-1551`. -/
+theorem sum_basis_character_effect_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Measurement (PauliScalar P) ι)
+    (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) :
+    (∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a)) • A.effect a) =
+      ∑ b : ZMod 2, phaseSign b •
+        (A.postprocess (fun a => fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a))).effect b := by
+  classical
+  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
+    (g := fun a : PauliScalar P => fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a))
+    (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 2))) (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro b _
+  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.smul_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro a ha
+  rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2]
+
+/-- A fixed basis character costs at most four times the field measurement
+consistency defect. The question distribution and basis coordinate are retained
+exactly. This proves the final conversion in blueprint
+`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, without assuming a bound on that defect. -/
+theorem basis_character_opDistSq_le_four_consistencyDefect
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {X ιA ιB : Type*}
+    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
+    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
+    (μ : Distribution X) (A : X → Measurement (PauliScalar P) ιA)
+    (B : X → Measurement (PauliScalar P) ιB)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) :
+    opDistSq μ
+      (fun x => heteroKron
+        (∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a)) • (A x).effect a) 1)
+      (fun x => heteroKron 1
+        (∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a)) • (B x).effect a)) ψ ≤
+      4 * consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect a)) ψ := by
+  classical
+  let f := fun a : PauliScalar P => fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a)
+  let A' := fun x => (A x).postprocess f
+  let B' := fun x => (B x).postprocess f
+  have hdef := consistencyDefect_postprocess_le μ A B ψ f
+  have hfam := (opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect μ
+    (fun x => leftPlacedMeasurement (A' x))
+    (fun x => rightPlacedMeasurement (B' x)) ψ).trans
+      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdef (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
+  have hobs := povm_to_obs_of_measurements μ
+    (fun x => leftPlacedMeasurement (A' x))
+    (fun x => rightPlacedMeasurement (B' x)) phaseSign norm_phaseSign ψ
+  simp only [ZMod.card, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hobs
+  have hbound := hobs.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfam (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
+  simpa only [sum_basis_character_effect_eq, heteroKron_left_sum_smul,
+    heteroKron_right_sum_smul, leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement,
+    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne, ← mul_assoc, show (2 : ℝ) * 2 = 4 by norm_num]
+    using hbound
+
+/-- The final measurement-to-observable step of blueprint
+`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2, on the original six-register state.
+The measurement consistency defect is an explicit quantity, not an assumed
+bound. Proving its construction-scale bound remains the obligation
+`eq:qld-pulling-cons` of issue #520. -/
+theorem tildeObs_opDistSq_le_four_consistencyDefect
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
+    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
+    (W : PauliKind) (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) :
+    opDistSq (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
+      (fun u => S.placeSide .alice (tildeObs w .alice W u j))
+      (fun u => S.placeSide .bob (tildeObs w .bob W u j)) S.psiHat ≤
+      4 * consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
+        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W u a))
+        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W u a)) S.psiHat := by
+  classical
+  let M (side : PlayerSide) (u : PauliRegister P) :
+      Measurement (PauliScalar P) (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
+    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (tildeM w side W u)
+      (fun a => (tildeM_isProj w side W u a).nonneg) (sum_tildeM_eq_one w side W u)
+  let e := sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB
+  have h := basis_character_opDistSq_le_four_consistencyDefect
+    (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P)) (M .alice) (M .bob)
+    (reindexState e S.psiHat) j
+  have hd : opDistSq (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
+      (fun u => heteroKron (tildeObs w .alice W u j) 1)
+      (fun u => heteroKron 1 (tildeObs w .bob W u j)) (reindexState e S.psiHat) =
+      opDistSq (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
+        (fun u => S.placeSide .alice (tildeObs w .alice W u j))
+        (fun u => S.placeSide .bob (tildeObs w .bob W u j)) S.psiHat := by
+    unfold opDistSq opFamilyDistSq
+    simp only [Fintype.sum_unique]
+    apply avgOver_congr
+    intro u
+    rw [norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState, reindexOp_sub]
+    rfl
+  have hc : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
+      (fun u a => heteroKron (tildeM w .alice W u a) 1)
+      (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (tildeM w .bob W u a)) (reindexState e S.psiHat) =
+      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
+        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W u a))
+        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W u a)) S.psiHat := by
+    unfold consistencyDefect
+    apply avgOver_congr
+    intro u
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro a _
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro b _
+    by_cases hab : a = b
+    · simp only [hab, if_true]
+    · simp only [if_neg hab, consistency_term_eq_stateQForm]
+      rw [stateQForm_reindexState, reindexOp_mul]
+      rfl
+  change opDistSq _ (fun u => heteroKron (tildeObs w .alice W u j) 1)
+    (fun u => heteroKron 1 (tildeObs w .bob W u j)) _ ≤
+      4 * consistencyDefect _ (fun u a => heteroKron (tildeM w .alice W u a) 1)
+        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (tildeM w .bob W u a)) _ at h
+  rwa [hd, hc] at h
+
+end
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction.Consistency
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction.PullingDefect
+
+/-!
+# Self-consistency of the pulled-apart observables
+
+The difference-polynomial measurements reduce observable self-consistency to
+point self-consistency and polynomial collision. The global witness remains
+an explicit premise.
+
+## References
+
+- Blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis-given-global-pair`, Item 2.
+- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1476-1662`.
+- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex`, issue #123.
+- The joint source obligation for `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` is stated in
+  `Extraction.Construction`.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
+
+noncomputable section
+
+/-- Conditional self-consistency of the pulled-apart observables on Alice's and
+Bob's extraction blocks, averaged over the uniformly random Pauli register.
+This is the supplied-witness form of Item 2 in blueprint
+`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis-given-global-pair`, paper
+`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1476-1605`.
+
+The construction scale exposes the square-root game error and
+Schwartz--Zippel loss that the source absorbs into `deltaS`. The proof combines
+the evaluated difference-polynomial comparison, the collision bound, and the
+fixed-coordinate character conversion. It does not use the non-encoding mass
+or complement-absorption obligations.
+
+**Unfaithful:** The premise `w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG` is not constructed
+here from `lem:qld-4-7`. The missing source-facing composition is documented in
+`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex` and tracked by issue #123.
+Elimination: discharge the construction required by
+`exists_pulled_apart_consistency` using `exists_globalPairWitness`, including
+its missing zero-error case.
+The joint source obligation is stated separately in `Extraction.Construction`;
+this proof establishes only the supplied-witness estimate. -/
+theorem tildeObs_selfConsistent_ofGlobalPairWitness :
+    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧
+      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon deltaG : ℝ),
+        0 ≤ epsilon → epsilon ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ deltaG →
+          ∀ (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
+            (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
+            (j : Fin P.model.basisDim),
+            opDistSq (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
+              (fun u => S.placeSide .alice (tildeObs w .alice W u j))
+              (fun u => S.placeSide .bob (tildeObs w .bob W u j))
+              S.psiHat ≤
+                deltaConstructPaulis C epsilon deltaG P.m P.d P.q := by
+  have hcard : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
+  refine ⟨48 + 32 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ), by linarith, ?_⟩
+  intro P epsilon deltaG hepsilon hepsilon_one hdeltaG S w W j
+  have hbound := (tildeObs_opDistSq_le_pulling_eval_add w W j).trans
+    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
+      (add_le_add (pullingMeas_eval_consistencyDefect_le w W) (le_refl _))
+      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4))
+  have heps : epsilon ≤ Real.sqrt epsilon := Real.le_sqrt_self_iff.mpr hepsilon_one
+  have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_nonneg epsilon
+  have hratio : 0 ≤ (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q :=
+    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
+  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heps
+    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 32) hcard)
+  refine hbound.trans ?_
+  unfold deltaConstructPaulis
+  rw [Nat.cast_mul]
+  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hcard hdeltaG, mul_nonneg hcard hratio]
+
+end
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction.BlockMeasurement
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction.PullingPointConsistency
+
+/-!
+# Evaluated consistency of the difference-polynomial measurements
+
+The exact overlap identities identify the consistency with the opposite
+player's point measurement with the consistency supplied by the global witness.
+
+## References
+
+- Blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2.
+- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1495-1545`.
+- Issue #520; the global witness is supplied, not constructed.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder Classical
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
+
+noncomputable section
+
+/-- The Alice evaluation defect is bounded by the supplied global consistency
+error, with no decoder correction or non-encoding mass term. -/
+theorem pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_alice {P : AdmissibleParams}
+    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
+    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
+    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice
+        (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
+      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤
+        deltaG := by
+  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
+  let pulled := fun u => S.blockMeasurement .alice
+    ((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
+  let point := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BB' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
+  let marginal := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AA'
+    ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
+  let expanded := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BA'' (S.pointMeasExp .bob W u)
+  have hp := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu pulled point S.psiHat
+    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
+  have hm := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu marginal expanded S.psiHat
+    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
+  have heq : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (pulled u).effect a)
+      (fun u a => (point u).effect a) S.psiHat =
+      consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
+        (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat := by
+    rw [hp, hm]
+    apply congrArg (1 - ·)
+    apply avgOver_congr
+    intro u
+    simp only [pulled, point, marginal, expanded, ProjectiveSetting.blockMeasurement_effect,
+      ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect]
+    change (∑ a, stateQForm S.psiHat (S.placeSide .alice
+      (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) *
+      S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))) = _
+    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_pullingMeas_eval_mul_pointMeas]
+    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum]
+    exact congrArg (stateQForm S.psiHat)
+      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .AA' W u
+        (fun a => S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))).symm
+  have hbound := marginalPoly_pointMeas_consistent_alice w W
+  change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
+    (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ deltaG at hbound
+  exact heq.le.trans hbound
+
+/-- Bob's evaluation defect has the same bound, using the Bob point-consistency
+estimate of the supplied witness and its `BB'`--`AB''` placements. -/
+theorem pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_bob {P : AdmissibleParams}
+    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
+    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
+    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
+      (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob
+        (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤
+        deltaG := by
+  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
+  let pulled := fun u => S.blockMeasurement .bob
+    ((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
+  let point := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AA' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .alice W u))
+  let marginal := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BB'
+    ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
+  let expanded := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AB'' (S.pointMeasExp .alice W u)
+  have hp := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu point pulled S.psiHat
+    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
+  have hm := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu marginal expanded S.psiHat
+    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
+  have heq : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (point u).effect a)
+      (fun u a => (pulled u).effect a) S.psiHat =
+      consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
+        (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat := by
+    rw [hp, hm]
+    apply congrArg (1 - ·)
+    apply avgOver_congr
+    intro u
+    simp only [pulled, point, marginal, expanded, ProjectiveSetting.blockMeasurement_effect,
+      ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect]
+    change (∑ a, stateQForm S.psiHat
+      (S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) * S.placeSide .bob
+        (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))) = _
+    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_pointMeas_mul_pullingMeas_eval]
+    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum]
+    exact congrArg (stateQForm S.psiHat)
+      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .BB' W u
+        (fun a => S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a))).symm
+  have hbound := marginalPoly_pointMeas_consistent_bob w W
+  change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
+    (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ deltaG at hbound
+  exact heq.le.trans hbound
+
+/-- Tensoring the strategy state with the two normalized EPR states preserves
+the point-measurement consistency defect. This is the six-register form of
+the point self-consistency used at `eq:qld-pulling-3`. -/
+theorem point_consistencyDefect_psiHat {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
+    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (W : PauliKind) :
+    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+        (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
+        (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat =
+      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) 1)
+        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.toStrategy.ψ := by
+  exact S.consistencyDefect_placePlayers
+    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+    (fun u => S.pointMeas .alice W u) (fun u => S.pointMeas .bob W u)
+
+/-- The evaluated difference-polynomial measurements are self-consistent.
+Agreement and two squared-distance triangle inequalities combine the two
+opposite-player comparisons with the original point self-consistency.
+The error is linear in the supplied witness error, as required before
+the collision step `eq:qld-pulling-12`. -/
+theorem pullingMeas_eval_consistencyDefect_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
+    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
+    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
+    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
+        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice
+          (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
+        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob
+          (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
+        S.psiHat ≤ 12 * deltaG + 8 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * epsilon := by
+  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
+  let A := fun u => S.blockMeasurement .alice
+    ((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
+  let B := fun u => S.blockMeasurement .bob
+    ((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
+  let PA := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AA'
+    (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .alice W u))
+  let PB := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BB'
+    (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
+  have hA := (opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect mu A PB S.psiHat).trans
+    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_alice w W)
+      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
+  have hB := (opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect mu PA B S.psiHat).trans
+    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_bob w W)
+      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
+  have hpoint : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (PA u).effect a)
+      (fun u a => (PB u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * epsilon := by
+    change consistencyDefect mu
+      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
+      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤ _
+    rw [point_consistencyDefect_psiHat]
+    exact point_self_consistency_le S W
+  have hP := (opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect mu PA PB S.psiHat).trans
+    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoint (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
+  rw [opFamilyDistSq_symm] at hP
+  have hAP := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le mu _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ hA hP
+  have hAB := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le mu _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ hAP hB
+  have hproj (side : PlayerSide) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
+      Measurement.IsProjective (S.blockMeasurement side
+        ((pullingMeas w side W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))) :=
+    S.blockMeasurement_isProjective side _
+      (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective _ (pullingMeas_isProjective w side W) _)
+  have hdef := consistencyDefect_le_opFamilyDistSq_of_projective mu A B S.psiHat
+    (hproj .alice) (hproj .bob)
+  exact hdef.trans (hAB.trans (by ring_nf; rfl))
+
+end
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT
