    33	/-- Placing a tensor with an identity on Bob's last register recovers `BB'`. -/
    34	theorem placeSide_bob_tensor_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    35	    (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)) :

    40	  split_ifs <;> rfl

    45	    (A : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob))

    47	    S.placePlayer .alice A * S.placeSide .bob (heteroKron B T) =

    56	/-- Bob's extraction-block placement preserves finite sums. -/
    57	theorem placeSide_bob_finset_sum (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    58	    {I : Type*} (s : Finset I) (B : I → Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    59	    S.placeSide .bob (∑ i ∈ s, B i) = ∑ i ∈ s, S.placeSide .bob (B i) := by
    60	  classical
    61	  change reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    62	    (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA)) (∑ i ∈ s, B i)) = _
    63	  rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_right]
    64	  ext row col

    68	/-- The convolution formula with its second outcome solved for. This is the
    69	third line of the overlap calculation in paper lines 1483--1492. -/
    70	theorem pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    71	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    72	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
    73	    (S.pointMeasExp side W u).effect a =
    74	      ∑ b : PauliScalar P, heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect b)
    75	        (tauDotProj W (indicatorVec u) (a - b)) := by
    76	  classical
    77	  change S.expPointOp side W u a = _
    78	  rw [S.expPointOp_eq_convolution]
    79	  simp only [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    80	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    81	  intro b _
    82	  have h (c : PauliScalar P) : b + c = a ↔ c = a - b := by
    83	    rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, add_comm]
    84	  simp only [h, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]

    92	theorem sum_pointMeas_mul_tildeM_eq_decoded_overlap
    93	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    94	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
    95	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :

    98	      ∑ g : Poly P, S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
    99	        S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect
   100	          (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))) := by
   101	  classical
   102	  simp only [tildeM, S.placeSide_bob_finset_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
   103	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   104	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   105	  intro g _
   106	  simp only [S.placePlayer_alice_mul_placeSide_bob_tensor]
   107	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← S.place_finset_sum,
   108	    S.pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub .alice W u]

   111	/-- The pulled-apart consistency defect is one minus the decoded overlap.
   112	This combines completeness with the first three lines of the source's
   113	calculation, still without imposing an encoding restriction. -/
   114	theorem tildeM_consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_decoded_overlap
   115	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   116	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   117	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   118	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
   119	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a)) S.psiHat =
   120	      1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   121	        ∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   122	          (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
   123	            S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect
   124	              (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) := by
   125	  classical
   126	  let point := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
   127	    S.placedMeasurement .AA' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .alice W u))
   128	  let pulled : (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) → Measurement (PauliScalar P)
   129	      (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := fun u =>
   130	    Measurement.ofSumEqOne
   131	      (fun a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a))
   132	      (fun a => by
   133	        apply ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg
   134	        exact kronecker_nonneg Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg
   135	          (tildeM_isProj w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a).nonneg)
   136	      (by
   137	        rw [← S.placeSide_bob_finset_sum, sum_tildeM_eq_one]
   138	        change reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   139	          (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   140	            (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
   141	        rw [heteroKron_one_one]
   142	        ext row col
   143	        simp [reindexOp, Matrix.one_apply])
   144	  have h := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap
   145	    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) point pulled S.psiHat
   146	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   147	  change consistencyDefect _ _ _ S.psiHat = 1 - avgOver _ (fun u =>
   148	    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   149	      (S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) *
   150	        S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a))) at h
   151	  refine h.trans ?_
   152	  congr 1
   153	  apply avgOver_congr
   154	  intro u
   155	  rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_pointMeas_mul_tildeM_eq_decoded_overlap,
   156	    stateQForm_finset_sum]

   159	/-- Replacing polynomial evaluation by decoded evaluation loses at most the
   160	mass of the non-encoding outcomes. This is the support-restricted replacement
   161	for the fourth line of paper lines 1483--1492. No mass estimate is assumed. -/
   162	theorem marginal_eval_overlap_le_decoded_add_nonencoding
   163	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   164	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
   165	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   166	    (∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   167	      (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
   168	        S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1)))) ≤
   169	      (∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   170	        (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
   171	          S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect
   172	            (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) +
   173	      ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
   174	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g)) := by
   175	  classical
   176	  have hpos (g : Poly P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
   177	      0 ≤ stateQForm S.psiHat
   178	        (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
   179	          S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a)) :=
   180	    stateQForm_nonneg _ (S.place_mul_place_nonneg .BB' .AB'' (by trivial)
   181	      ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).pos g) ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).pos a))
   182	  have hsum (g : Poly P) :
   183	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   184	        (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
   185	          S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a))) =
   186	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g)) := by
   187	    have hc : (∑ a : PauliScalar P,
   188	        S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a)) = 1 :=
   189	      (S.placedMeasurement .AB'' (S.pointMeasExp .alice W u)).sum_eq_one
   190	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hc, mul_one]
   191	  rw [Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   192	  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   193	  intro g _
   194	  by_cases hg : IsEncoding g
   195	  · simp only [hg, not_true_eq_false, if_false, add_zero]
   196	    rw [decodeFq_dotProduct_indicatorVec hg u]
   197	    rfl
   198	  · simp only [hg, not_false_eq_true, if_true]
   199	    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun a _ => hpos g a)
   200	      (Finset.mem_univ (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))
   201	    rw [hsum] at hle
   202	    exact hle.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (hpos g _))

    31	/-- Placing a tensor with an identity on Alice's last register recovers `AA'`. -/
    32	theorem placeSide_alice_tensor_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    33	    (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) :
    34	    S.placeSide .alice (heteroKron B (1 : Op (PauliRegister P))) = S.place .AA' B := by
    35	  ext row col
    36	  simp [placeSide, sixRegExtractionEquiv, reindexOp, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
    37	    place, Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and, mul_ite]
    38	  split_ifs <;> rfl
    39	
    40	/-- The factors on `AA'A''` and `B` can be regrouped on `AA'` and `BA''`
    41	without exchanging registers or assuming symmetry of the strategy. -/
    42	theorem placeSide_alice_tensor_mul_placePlayer_bob (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    43	    (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) (T : Op (PauliRegister P))
    44	    (A : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) :
    45	    S.placeSide .alice (heteroKron B T) * S.placePlayer .bob A =
    46	      S.place .AA' B * S.place .BA'' (heteroKron A T) := by
    47	  classical
    48	  ext row col
    49	  simp [placePlayer, placeSide, sixRegExtractionEquiv, reindexOp, heteroKron,
    50	    Matrix.kronecker, place, Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    51	    Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and, mul_ite, ite_mul]
    52	  split_ifs <;> ac_rfl

    54	/-- Alice's extraction-block placement preserves finite sums. -/
    55	theorem placeSide_alice_finset_sum (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    56	    {I : Type*} (s : Finset I) (B : I → Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA)) :
    57	    S.placeSide .alice (∑ i ∈ s, B i) = ∑ i ∈ s, S.placeSide .alice (B i) := by
    58	  classical
    59	  change reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    60	    (heteroKron (∑ i ∈ s, B i) (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = _
    61	  rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_left]
    62	  ext row col
    63	  simp only [placeSide, reindexOp, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    64	    Matrix.sum_apply]

    66	end ProjectiveSetting

    68	/-- The Alice-pulled/Bob-point overlap is exactly the expanded-point overlap
    69	at the decoded value. This is the register-interchanged version of the first
    70	three lines of the calculation in paper lines 1483--1492. -/
    71	theorem sum_tildeM_mul_pointMeas_eq_decoded_overlap
    72	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    73	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
    74	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    75	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a) *
    76	      S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) =
    77	      ∑ g : Poly P, S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
    78	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
    79	          (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))) := by
    80	  classical
    81	  simp only [tildeM, S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    82	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    83	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    84	  intro g _
    85	  simp only [S.placeSide_alice_tensor_mul_placePlayer_bob]
    86	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← S.place_finset_sum,
    87	    S.pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub .bob W u]
    88	  rfl
    89	
    90	/-- The Alice-pulled/Bob-point consistency defect is one minus the decoded
    91	overlap. This uses completeness but no encoding restriction or mass estimate. -/
    92	theorem tildeM_consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_decoded_overlap'
    93	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    94	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
    95	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    96	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
    97	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat =
    98	      1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
    99	        ∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   100	          (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   101	            S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
   102	              (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) := by
   103	  classical
   104	  let point := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
   105	    S.placedMeasurement .BB' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
   106	  let pulled : (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) → Measurement (PauliScalar P)
   107	      (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := fun u =>
   108	    Measurement.ofSumEqOne
   109	      (fun a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
   110	      (fun a => by
   111	        apply ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg
   112	        exact kronecker_nonneg (tildeM_isProj w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a).nonneg
   113	          Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
   114	      (by
   115	        rw [← S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, sum_tildeM_eq_one]
   116	        change reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   117	          (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   118	            (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
   119	        rw [heteroKron_one_one]
   120	        ext row col
   121	        simp [reindexOp, Matrix.one_apply])
   122	  have h := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap
   123	    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) pulled point S.psiHat
   124	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   125	  change consistencyDefect _ _ _ S.psiHat = 1 - avgOver _ (fun u =>
   126	    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   127	      (S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a) *
   128	        S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))) at h
   129	  refine h.trans ?_
   130	  congr 1
   131	  apply avgOver_congr
   132	  intro u
   133	  rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_tildeM_mul_pointMeas_eq_decoded_overlap,
   134	    stateQForm_finset_sum]
   135	
   136	open scoped Classical in
   137	/-- On Alice's marginal, replacing polynomial evaluation by decoded evaluation
   138	loses at most the non-encoding mass. This is the support-restricted version of
   139	the fourth line of paper lines 1483--1492, with the players interchanged. -/
   140	theorem marginal_eval_overlap_le_decoded_add_nonencoding'
   141	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   142	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
   143	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   144	    (∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   145	      (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   146	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1)))) ≤
   147	      (∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   148	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   149	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
   150	            (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) +
   151	      ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
   152	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g)) := by
   153	  classical
   154	  have hpos (g : Poly P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
   155	      0 ≤ stateQForm S.psiHat
   156	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   157	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) :=
   158	    stateQForm_nonneg _ (S.place_mul_place_nonneg .AA' .BA'' (by trivial)
   159	      ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).pos g) ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).pos a))
   160	  have hsum (g : Poly P) :
   161	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   162	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   163	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))) =
   164	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g)) := by
   165	    have hc : (∑ a : PauliScalar P,
   166	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) = 1 :=
   167	      (S.placedMeasurement .BA'' (S.pointMeasExp .bob W u)).sum_eq_one
   168	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hc, mul_one]
   169	  rw [Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   170	  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   171	  intro g _
   172	  by_cases hg : IsEncoding g
   173	  · simp only [hg, not_true_eq_false, if_false, add_zero]
   174	    rw [decodeFq_dotProduct_indicatorVec hg u]
   175	    rfl
   176	  · simp only [hg, not_false_eq_true, if_true]
   177	    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun a _ => hpos g a)
   178	      (Finset.mem_univ (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))
   179	    rw [hsum] at hle
   180	    exact hle.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (hpos g _))

     8	/-!
     9	# Consistency with encoding-supported reference measurements
    10	
    11	The Pauli-basis check remains a consistency estimate after adjoining the
    12	perfectly correlated ideal point measurement. Schwartz-Zippel then controls
    13	mass outside the encoding image by evaluated reference inconsistency.
    14	
    15	## References
    16	
    17	- Blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass` and `lem:qld-nonencoding-mass-bound`.
    18	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:197-264,383-418`.
    19	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.

    21	  with the ideal Pauli point projectors.

    35	/-- For commuting families, reversing the order of the measurements preserves
    36	the consistency defect. This is finite-sum algebra for opposite placements. -/
    37	theorem consistencyDefect_comm_of_commute {X A I : Type*}
    38	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    39	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (mu : Distribution X)
    40	    (first second : X → A → Op I) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I)
    41	    (hcomm : ∀ x a b, first x a * second x b = second x b * first x a) :
    42	    consistencyDefect mu first second psi = consistencyDefect mu second first psi := by
    43	  unfold consistencyDefect
    44	  apply avgOver_congr
    45	  intro x
    46	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    47	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    48	  intro b _
    49	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    50	  intro a _
    51	  simp only [hcomm x a b, eq_comm]
    52	
    53	/-- A polynomial measurement's mass outside the encoding image is at most
    54	its evaluated inconsistency with an encoding-supported reference, plus `md/q`.
    55	This is the Schwartz-Zippel step in blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`.
    56	The reference support is explicit because this auxiliary applies to any POVM;
    57	the concrete reference above proves it without an additional strategy premise. -/
    58	theorem mass_outside_encoding_le_evaluated_defect {P : AdmissibleParams}
    59	    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    60	    (meas : Measurement (Poly P) I) (reference : Measurement (Poly P) J)
    61	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1)
    62	    (hsupport : ∀ g, ¬ IsEncoding g → reference.effect g = 0) :
    63	    (∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
    64	      stateQForm psi (heteroKron (meas.effect g) 1)) ≤
    65	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    66	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((meas.postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
    67	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((reference.postprocess
    68	          (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) psi + (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
    69	  classical
    70	  have hmass := mass_outside_support_le_point_defect meas reference psi
    71	    (Finset.univ.filter IsEncoding) (by simpa using hsupport)
    72	  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hmass
    73	  have hcollision := SandwichProduct.point_codeword_defect_le_avg_evaluated_add
    74	    meas reference psi evalPoly ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) hpsi
    75	    (by positivity) poly_eval_collision_le
    76	  refine hmass.trans (hcollision.trans_eq ?_)
    77	  rw [SandwichProduct.consistencyDefect_placed_eq_avg_point]

    81	/-- The ideal point measurement has zero off-diagonal mass on its EPR pair.
    82	This follows from the existing unit diagonal-overlap calculation. -/
    83	private theorem tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero {P : AdmissibleParams}
    84	    (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    85	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, ∑ b : PauliScalar P, if a = b then 0 else
    86	      stateQForm (eprState (PauliRegister P))
    87	        (heteroKron (tauPointProj W u a) (tauPointProj W u b))) = 0 := by
    88	  have h := point_defect_eq (leftPlacedMeasurement (tauPointMeas W u))

    91	    placed_product_stateQForm_eq, tauPointMeas, eprState_norm, one_pow,
    92	    sum_tauPointProj_pair_stateQForm_eprState, sub_self] using h

    94	/-- Adjoining the ideal point outcomes preserves the Pauli-basis check on the
    95	two-player expanded state, in the point--Pauli orientation. -/
    96	theorem point_encodingPauli_consistency_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
    97	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (W : PauliKind) :
    98	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    99	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a) 1)
   100	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (((S.encodingPauliMeas .bob W).postprocess
   101	          (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) =
   102	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   103	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) 1)
   104	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u).effect a))
   105	        S.toStrategy.ψ := by
   106	  have h := consistencyDefect_convolution_eq_of_perfect
   107	    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   108	    (S.pointMeas .alice W) (S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W)
   109	    (tauPointMeas W) (tauPointMeas W) S.toStrategy.ψ
   110	    (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)
   111	    (tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero W)
   112	  simpa only [pointMeasExp, Measurement.ofSumEqOne, expPointOp_eq_convolution,
   113	    encodingPauliMeas_eval_effect_eq_convolution, tauPointMeas,
   114	    ExtendedLineGame.pairState] using h

   116	/-- The same exact preservation holds in the Pauli--point orientation. -/
   117	theorem encodingPauli_point_consistency_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
   118	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (W : PauliKind) :
   119	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   120	        (fun u a => heteroKron (((S.encodingPauliMeas .alice W).postprocess
   121	          (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
   122	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))
   123	        (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) =
   124	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   125	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u).effect a) 1)
   126	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))
   127	        S.toStrategy.ψ := by

   130	    (S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W) (S.pointMeas .bob W)
   131	    (tauPointMeas W) (tauPointMeas W) S.toStrategy.ψ
   132	    (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)
   133	    (tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero W)
   134	  simpa only [pointMeasExp, Measurement.ofSumEqOne, expPointOp_eq_convolution,

   136	    ExtendedLineGame.pairState] using h

   148	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))
   149	        S.toStrategy.ψ := by

   151	    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   152	    (S.pointMeas .alice W) (S.pointMeas .bob W)
   153	    (tauPointMeas W) (tauPointMeas W) S.toStrategy.ψ
   154	    (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)
   155	    (tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero W)

   161	/-- The right-hand marginal version of the support estimate, obtained by
   162	interchanging the two tensor factors and using the same collision bound. -/
   163	theorem right_mass_outside_encoding_le_evaluated_defect {P : AdmissibleParams}
   164	    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   165	    (reference : Measurement (Poly P) I) (meas : Measurement (Poly P) J)
   166	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1)
   167	    (hsupport : ∀ g, ¬ IsEncoding g → reference.effect g = 0) :
   168	    (∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
   169	      stateQForm psi (heteroKron 1 (meas.effect g))) ≤
   170	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))

docs/blueprint_style_guide.md:183:A theorem, lemma, proposition, or corollary node is **fully formalized in Lean if and only if it has both markers**: statement-level `\leanok` in the statement block and proof-level `\leanok` in the proof block. Statement-level without proof-level means “the statement has been transcribed and matched, but the proof is not yet certified complete.” Definitions have no proof block, so statement-level `\leanok` alone is enough there.
docs/blueprint_style_guide.md:200:**Current CI behavior.** The advisory Blueprint ↔ Lean sync check in [`docs/ci-blueprint-sync.md`](ci-blueprint-sync.md) distinguishes the two placements. Only proof-level `\leanok` whose axiom closure contains `sorryAx` (or whose harness output cannot be parsed) is reported as an **error**. Statement-level-only `\leanok` with the same finding is downgraded to a **warning**, because statement-level does not claim proof completeness. Each audit line is annotated with the observed placement so reviewers can tell statement-sync work apart from proof-completion work.

## Review
F1 is a factual dependency contradiction. `global_marginal_encoding_consistency` quantifies over a supplied `GlobalPairWitness` at line 189. Its documentation should instead say that it does not construct the witness and does not assume the non-encoding support estimate.

For F2, the paper states `eq:qld-pulling-cons` at `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1495-1499` as the average comparison of Alice’s and Bob’s pulled-apart measurements. This PR now supplies that conditional chain through `pullingMeas_eval_consistencyDefect_le`, `tildeM_consistencyDefect_le_pulling_eval_add`, and `tildeObs_selfConsistent_ofGlobalPairWitness`. Lines 16-17 and 126-130 of `CharacterConsistency.lean` should identify the remaining obligation accurately: construction of the common global witness and source-facing composition under issue #123, not the supplied-witness pulling estimate.

For F3, `NonencodingSupport.lean:83-155` proves `tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero` and uses it with `consistencyDefect_convolution_eq_of_perfect` in all three concrete ideal-point orientations. The header and theorem documentation in `TensorConsistency.lean` should no longer describe this specialization as pending.

The Lean proof structure otherwise appears coherent, and the conditional extraction declarations remain clearly separated from the source-facing theorem. The new `sorry` in `exists_pulled_apart_consistency` is explicitly documented as the source-facing issue #123 obligation; the other changed-file proof holes are pre-existing and marked. I found no unmarked proof-integrity bypass or additional source-statement drift. Exact-head local CI passed, and the patch passes `git diff --check`.
